en: A sepia-toned photograph of an ancient stone structure in a mountainous landscape. The scene shows a large curved arrangement of stone blocks forming what looks like a small ancient stadium or theater, with a flat open ground in the middle. On the left is a rocky outcrop and a low stone platform; on the right, a semi-circular ring of squared blocks. Two people in traditional-looking rural clothing walk across the open area toward the camera. In the distance are rolling hills and higher mountains under partly cloudy skies.
